REFERENCE · ROUND ORDER

Phases of a Round

I
Recruitment
  • Buy cards
  • Buy hoplites
  • Upgrade units
Card cost
1st=2nd=3rd=…
Each extra card in the same round costs +1 resource. Resets to 1 next round.
II
Build Choose one:
  • Build an outpost
  • Upgrade an outpost
  • Pay to change an outpost’s production type
III
Movement
Standard movement
123
3 steps, all units
Cavalry movement
12
2 steps, cavalry only
IV
Battle
1 Archer volley
Attacking archers (ones that moved into the battle) fire 1 shot each. Outposts fire 1 shot.
2 Combat
Each player chooses a player to roll against. Outposts can be destroyed.
V
Rectification
  • Armies may retreat, for example after both sides agree to end a battle
  • Also applies if a player has more than 6 units on one tile
  • If a retreat starts a new battle, it’s fought here, and the retreating army can’t retreat again
VI
Collection
  • Collect victory points and everything else your outposts produce
